snippet.title: Equinox: Homecoming - Out Now in Early Access on Steam
snippet.description:
Saddle up together and investigate an occult mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic Alderwood Island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. Equinox: Homecoming is a MMORPG that's perfect for fans of cozy, open-world exploration, horses, and murder mysteries! 

Wishlist today and learn more over on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3258290/Equinox_Homecoming/
